items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the p300 handles 100 µL (about 220 µL aspirated including the default disposal volume, under 300). The simulator checks all passed.
The checks tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination passed. distribute with new_tip='always' picks up one tip and drops it at the end. The has_tip guard is a harmless extra.
The code moves 100 µL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and B1 with the p300, and end_state:plate shows [100, 100]. The extra disposal-volume aspirate is blown out and does not change the outcome.
Reservoir is in slot 1 and plate in slot 2 with the required labels. Tip racks are in slots 10 and 11, with p20 on left and p300 on right.
p300.distribute(100, reservoir A1, [plate A1, plate B1]) puts exactly 100 µL in each target well and touches no other wells.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly, and all measured checks pass. It uses the p300 with distribute to put 100 µL into each of plate A1 and B1, with correct labware, slots and tip handling.
